sourceSnapshot.sourceSummary: Without another fixed-share heir the grandfather receives the greater of one third of the estate or muqasama; with fixed shares he receives the greatest of one sixth of the estate, one third of the remainder, or muqasama of the remainder.

explicitConditions: Only eligible full and paternal siblings compete.
Muqasama treats the grandfather as one male sibling.
explicitExclusions: Akdariyya and Mu‘adda use their dedicated paths.
Exhaustion at or below one sixth uses KZ-FR-021.
